description: This file is the implementation source code for the ActivityMonitor plugin, which is responsible for monitoring application memory and CPU usage, managing processes, and generating events based on thresholds. It includes class definitions, methods for resource tracking, configuration management, and inter-process communication.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: Main plugin class responsible for process and resource monitoring, event generation, and JSON-RPC interface implementation.

classes.name: MemoryInfo
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for system resource querying, process information, and registry handling.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Data structure for maintaining individual application monitoring parameters and state.

classes.name: MonitorParams
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating overall monitoring parameters and configuration state.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage details for a specified application process ID.

methods.name: getAllMemoryUsage
methods.description: Gathers memory usage statistics for all monitored applications and system.

methods.name: enableMonitoring
methods.description: Starts resource monitoring for a list of applications with specified sampling intervals and thresholds.

methods.name: threadRun
methods.description: Static thread function to execute the monitoring loop.

methods.name: monitoring
methods.description: Main monitoring loop performing periodic checks and event generation.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Sends notification when memory usage exceeds or recedes below thresholds.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Sends notification when CPU usage exceeds or recedes below thresholds.
